desc: Implement the primary index-block sqrt decomposition end-to-end in Python, including block construction, block-pair sum computation, 2D prefix over block pairs, row sweep for partial-A/full-B contributions, and column sweep for full-A/partial-B contributions.
Implement adaptive partial-partial handling: group queries by (A-block, B-block), build a full prefix table for heavy groups, and use sorted-prefix merge with per-group caching for light groups.
Validate on the provided samples and edge cases such as N=1, K=1, prefixes exactly at block boundaries, last short blocks, and equal values.

If the primary implementation fails samples or has unacceptable performance/memory, switch to a different approach (e.g., persistent/wavelet prefix queries with heavy-prefix caching, or Mo/Hilbert ordering) instead of continuing to polish the same code.
